quotes.text: Retention policy: shared Try download cache is capped at 5 GiB/7 days; build snapshots 10 GiB/14 days; inactive assessment and task evidence are removed while verdict state remains. Active tasks acquire storage leases. Imported Try history lacks saved source selection and is intentionally inactive; expose it as `imported-history`. [Task 2]

source.basis: Recorded interpretation. Original private evidence is unavailable to other consumers; this summary is not independent verification.
